verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events can ingest from streaming sources like Kafka and Google Pub/Sub as well as its SDKs and HTTP API, so it can take in feed-style data beyond SDK instrumentation. The rest of the evidence covers first-party collection (websites, mobile apps, backends) and outbound reverse-ETL syncs, not pulling customer data in from third-party cloud apps. Missing for 10: documented inbound connectors for third-party SaaS/cloud apps (e.g., CRM, payments, support tools), any catalog of ingestion sources beyond streaming buses, and independent corroboration of third-party data ingestion.
